points.text: The linked article reports that ZETTROX's GitHub repository and account now answer 404, and omonkey's private build was taken down the same day.
The linked article reports that Take-Two's DMCA notice takes down GTA VI PC port and 3,007 GitHub repos.
The tracker records that CGBJ now claims the stage "Playable", up from "Runnable".

sentences.text: The linked article reports that ZETTROX's GitHub repo and omonkey's build vanished from the board, with no DMCA notice published.
The linked article reports that Take-Two issued a DMCA notice that disabled Leonida and 3,007 forks, calling the project a derivative of GTA VI.
The linked article reports that the DMCA notice was applied to the entire fork network, making all contributors unavailable on GitHub.
MakeUseOf reports fake GTA 6 PC installers steal accounts.
TweakTown reports players scanned an in-game GTA 6 QR code.
TweakTown reports Rockstar's website was seized by authorities.
The linked article says private builds reach Jason's first mission, while Notebookcheck reports a game dump runs on a PS5 jailbreak.
GameGPU reports Portheon announced a fully playable PC build at 30 FPS, while Destructoid reports steady progress but Rockstar hinders emulation devs.
